paper_title: Search for ultralight axion dark matter in a side-band analysis of a 199Hg free-spin precession signal
notes: PSI 199Hg free-spin-precession sideband search. Constrains axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN (units GeV^-1, from derivative Lagrangian), assuming gann=gapp but system primarily sensitive to neutron coupling. Mass range 1e-16 to ~1.4e-13 eV, peak sensitivity g_aNN ~3.5e-6 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. Data extracted approximately from text/abstract (no numeric table); Figure 4 gives the actual mass-dependent exclusion curve. Values are in GeV^-1, NOT the dimensionless g_an convention. rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3 conservative lower bound used. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 4))
